channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Iran says US has responded to its latest peace proposal
item.description: Iran claims the US responded to its peace proposal, though the US has not confirmed this. Trump reportedly called the proposal unacceptable. The US is yet to formally confirm it has responded.

item.title: Iran says it has received US response to its latest offer for talks
item.description: Iran says it received a US response to its offer for talks, which have continually failed under the fragile ceasefire. Peace talks between the US and Iran have continually failed under the fragile ceasefire.

item.title: World Press Freedom Day marked in Gaza as journalist death toll rises
item.description: Palestinian journalists in Gaza marked World Press Freedom Day by honouring colleagues killed by Israel, as the death toll rises. Palestinian journalists in Gaza marked World Press Freedom Day by honouring colleagues killed and targeted by Israel.

item.title: Is Israel expanding into Gaza despite ceasefire?
item.description: Israel is expanding into Gaza despite a ceasefire, according to Redi Tlhabi's discussion with Ray Adams Row Farr. Redi Tlhabi speaks to Ray Adams Row Farr from Forensic Architecture about Israel’s expansion into Gaza post-ceasefire.

item.title: Germany’s Merz downplays rift with Washington despite US troop drawdown
item.description: Germany's chancellor downplayed a rift with Washington over US troop drawdown, saying Iran criticism is unrelated. German chancellor says criticism of Donald Trump's strategy in Iran unrelated to troop withdrawal announcement.

item.title: Norway’s Northern Lights Nightmare
item.description: Norwegian authorities have warned tourists about scammers targeting those seeking to see the northern lights in the Arctic region, where tourism has surged in recent years. This Arctic region has seen a boom in tourism, but as tourists chase the northern lights, scammers chase their money.

item.title: How A.I. Is Transforming China’s Entertainment Industry
item.description: China's entertainment industry is experiencing disruption due to the rise of AI-generated microdramas, with celebrities threatening legal action and actors reporting job losses. A. I.-generated microdramas have taken off. Celebrities have threatened legal action against the use of their likeness, while actors say jobs have dried up.

item.title: German chancellor downplays row with Trump after troop drawdown announced
item.description: The US has reduced its troop presence in Germany to pre-Ukraine War levels, a move that has prompted a response from German officials. The US President returned the number of American troops stationed in Germany to pre-Ukraine War levels.

item.title: Germany's Merz says not 'giving up on working with Donald Trump'
item.description: German politician Friedrich Merz has stated that he remains open to working with US President Donald Trump despite recent tensions. Germany's Merz says not 'giving up on working with Donald Trump' Iosco County News Herald.

item.title: Carrick plays down permanent role talk after dramatic win over Liverpool
item.description: Michael Carrick played down talk of a permanent role after Manchester United's win over Liverpool. Carrick plays down permanent role talk after dramatic win over Liverpool.

item.title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian man in raid on Nablus in occupied West Ban
item.description: Israeli forces killed a 26-year-old Palestinian man in a raid on Nablus in the occupied West Bank. Israeli forces have raided the city of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, killing a 26-year-old man.

item.title: Iran says it is reviewing U.S. response to latest proposal
item.description: A bulk carrier near the Strait of Hormuz was reportedly under attack. The UK military confirmed the incident. Iran's Guards said the US faced two options: an impossible military operation or a bad deal.

item.title: Two US service members reported missing in Morocco, officials say
item.description: A search and rescue operation is underway in Morocco for two US service members who are believed to have been involved in an accident. A search and rescue operation is underway for the service members, who are believed to have been involved in an accident, according to authorities.

item.title: Investigators say Trump assassination suspect shot officer at press gala
item.description: A Secret Service agent was shot by a Trump assassination suspect at the White House correspondents' dinner. Secret Service agent at White House correspondents' dinner was 'definitively' hit by suspect's bullet, prosecutor says.

item.title: Israel court extends detention of Gaza flotilla activists
item.description: Israel detained Gaza flotilla activists after intercepting the ship in international waters near Greece. The Gaza-bound Flotilla was intercepted by Israeli authorities in international waters near Greece. Israel court extends detention of Gaza flotilla activists.

item.title: Floods and landslides kill at least 18 in Kenya
item.description: Floods and landslides in Kenya killed at least 18 people. Ongoing rains are causing the floods. Ongoing rains are causing floods and landslides in the East African nation. Floods and landslides kill at least 18 in Kenya.

item.title: Paramilitary forces drone strike kills at least five near Sudan capital: rights group
item.description: A drone strike near Sudan's capital killed at least five people. The Rapid Support Forces did not claim the attack. The Rapid Support Forces, which have been at war with the Sudanese Army for over three years, did not immediately claim the attack.

item.title: Nigerian, Beninese militias kill scores of herders
item.description: Nigerian and Beninese militias killed scores of herders in a crackdown on suspected al-Qaeda informants. Security personnel arrested young men door-to-door, shooting those who resisted. The operation targeted Fulani herding settlements.

item.title: Trump retaliates against NATO allies with security, economic measures
item.description: Trump imposed security and economic measures against NATO allies. Trump retaliates against NATO allies with security, economic measures MSN.

item.title: Israel court extends detention of two Gaza flotilla activists
item.description: An Israel court extended detention for two Gaza flotilla activists. Israel court extends detention of two Gaza flotilla activists.
